method.batch_runner_source:
import fcntl,hashlib,itertools,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path('/data/home/fg/transport-20261118')
batch=sys.argv[1];blocks=int(sys.argv[2]);variants=sys.argv[3:]
lock=open(root/'rig.lock','w');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
image='node@sha256:de170b39439eb0e5a3444ad7d60b015614a381e10fecae2e30ec9e735122f38d'
orders=list(itertools.permutations(variants))
manifest={v:hashlib.sha256((root/'bin'/(v+'-amd64')).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for v in variants}
(root/'results'/(batch+'-manifest.json')).write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
status=1
for process in ['chromium','Xvnc']:subprocess.run(['pkill','-STOP','-x',process],check=False)
try:
 for block in range(1,blocks+1):
  order=orders[(block-1)%len(orders)]
  for v in order:
   spec=f'{batch}-{v}-{block}';name=f'transport-{spec}'
   out=root/'results'/(spec+'.json');log=root/'results'/(spec+'.log')
   if out.exists() or log.exists():raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite '+spec)
   args=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name,'--runtime','runsc-netstack','--cpus','2','--memory','1280m','--memory-swap','1280m','--pids-limit','512','--network','none','--read-only','--tmpfs','/tmp:rw,size=256m','--cap-drop','ALL','--security-opt','no-new-privileges','-u','1000:1000','-e','MAKEFUN_SHOP_TOKEN=transport-local','-e','NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=256 --max-semi-space-size=1','-v',str(root)+':/probe:rw','-v','/data/home/fg/github-core-clone-01-kit:/kit:ro','--entrypoint','node',image,'/probe/rig/full-forge.mjs',f'/probe/bin/{v}-amd64',f'/probe/rig/{v}.json',f'/probe/results/{spec}.json']
   started=time.time()
   with open(log,'w') as f:
    try:subprocess.run(args,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=150,check=True)
    except BaseException:
     subprocess.run(['docker','rm','-f',name],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=False)
     raise
   x=json.loads(out.read_text())
   assert x['passed']==120 and x['state_sha256']=='a0e98d49854b961230227867235c8615858e006db3763f341ac6154af1445590'
   assert x['binary_sha256']==manifest[v]
   assert len(x['rows'])==12 and all(len(w['rounds'])==3 and 'error' not in w for w in x['perf']['workloads'])
   print(json.dumps({'spec':spec,'G_ms':x['perf']['perf_p50_us']/1000,'wall_seconds':round(time.time()-started,2),'p50s':{w['name']:w['p50_ms'] for w in x['perf']['workloads']}}),flush=True)
 status=0
finally:
 (root/'results'/(batch+'.exit')).write_text(str(status)+'\n')
 for process in ['chromium','Xvnc']:subprocess.run(['pkill','-CONT','-x',process],check=False)
